name: Michigan State University
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.74, 20.18% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 31.51%) (2025-26 CDS)
what_they_value: MSU는 입학이 경쟁적이지만 최소 요건은 없다고 밝히며, 고교 학업 성취, 교육과정의 강도와 질, 최근 성적 추이, 석차, (선택 제출) SAT/ACT, 리더십·재능·품행·경험의 다양성을 본다고 명시한다. CDS상 GPA가 유일한 Very Important 요소이고, 교과 엄격성과 에세이는 Important다. 관심 표현은 Considered.
what_they_value_en: MSU says admission is competitive but that there are no minimum requirements, and lists what it considers as academic performance in high school, the strength and quality of the curriculum, recent trends in academic performance, class rank, ACT or SAT results (optional), and leadership, talents, conduct and diversity of experience. Its CDS marks academic GPA as the only Very Important factor, with rigor of secondary school record and the application essay Important. Level of applicant's interest is Considered.
intro_ko: 미시간주의 대형 주립 연구대학으로 교육·경영·농생명 분야와 큰 캠퍼스 규모로 알려져 있다.
intro_en: A large public research university in Michigan, known for education, business and agricultural sciences on an expansive campus.
merit_intl: MSU international student scholarships (President's, Provost's, Dean's, 1855, Beaumont Tower, Global Community Scholars)
merit_note: MSU states that all international students admitted to MSU are automatically considered for its non-resident/international scholarships and that no application beyond the application for admission is required; published award levels are President's $15,000, Provost's $12,000, Dean's $10,000, 1855 Scholarship $7,000, Beaumont Tower $5,000 and Global Community Scholars $3,000 per year. Applying by the November 1 Early Action deadline is required for maximum scholarship consideration, and MSU notes that meeting the criteria does not guarantee an award.

name: North Carolina State University
gpa_note: 평균 GPA 3.84, 석차 제출자 중 상위 10% 이내 41% (제출 75%) (2025-26 CDS)
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.84, 41% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 75%) (2025-26 CDS)
what_they_value: NC State는 holistic review를 쓰되 4년 내내 경쟁력 있는 과목에서 받은 좋은 성적을 가장 먼저 본다고 밝힌다 — STEM·비즈니스 지원자는 precalculus까지의 수학이 기대된다. CDS상 교과 엄격성·GPA만 Very Important. 교실 밖 시간 사용, 성취의 맥락(과목 개설 여부·학교 환경), 에세이도 함께 보며, 지원 시 선택한 전공으로 직접 선발하므로 과목·활동과 전공의 정합성이 중요하다고 명시한다.
what_they_value_en: NC State says it uses a holistic review and looks first at strong grades in competitive courses across all four years of high school, with math through precalculus expected of competitive applicants to STEM and business programs; its CDS marks rigor of secondary school record and academic GPA as the only Very Important factors. The office says it also weighs how applicants spend time outside the classroom, the context in which achievements were earned (course availability, grading scale, community resources), and the essays. Because NC State admits students directly into the major selected on the application, it states that review depends on the major and on demonstrated fit between coursework, activities, and that field.
intro_ko: 노스캐롤라이나주의 대표 주립 연구대학으로 공학·농업·디자인 분야가 강하고, 리서치 트라이앵글 파크와 인접해 있다.
intro_en: North Carolina's leading public research university, strong in engineering, agriculture and design, and adjacent to Research Triangle Park.
merit_intl: NC State competitive merit-based scholarships (PACK ASSIST portal)
merit_note: NC State states that international applicants are not eligible for financial aid, but that a limited number of competitive merit-based scholarships are available to international students. Admitted students access the PACK ASSIST scholarship portal and must submit the general scholarship application; the Park Scholarship is restricted to U.S. citizens, permanent residents, or graduates of a U.S. high school.

name: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute
gpa_note: 평균 GPA 3.93, 석차 제출자 중 상위 10% 이내 63% (제출 28%) (2025-26 CDS)
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.93, 63% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 28%) (2025-26 CDS)
what_they_value: RPI는 CDS상 교과 엄격성·석차·GPA를 Very Important로, 에세이·추천서·활동·인성을 Important로 둔다. 시험 점수는 제출 선택제라 Considered다. 지원 시 단과대와 (가능하면) 구체적 전공을 고르게 하며, 원하는 프로그램을 최대한 구체적으로 밝히라고 권한다.
what_they_value_en: RPI's CDS marks rigor of secondary school record, class rank and academic GPA as Very Important, with the application essay, recommendations, extracurricular activities and character/personal qualities Important; level of applicant's interest is Considered. Standardized test scores are Considered rather than required, since RPI lets applicants choose whether to submit SAT or ACT scores. Applicants select a school and, where possible, a specific major, and RPI encourages them to be as specific as they can about the program they want.
intro_ko: 1824년 설립된 미국에서 가장 오래된 공과대학 중 하나로, 공학·컴퓨터과학 중심의 사립 연구대학이다.
intro_en: Founded in 1824, one of the oldest technological universities in the US — a private research university centered on engineering and computer science.
merit_intl: Rensselaer merit scholarships for international undergraduates; Rensselaer Medal
merit_note: RPI states that it offers a limited number of merit-based scholarship opportunities for international undergraduate students, including awards of up to $20,000 per year, and that additional institutional funding may be available to recipients of the Rensselaer Medal Scholarship or Division I athletic scholarships. The Rensselaer Medal is awarded through partner high schools worldwide to students distinguished in mathematics and science and is worth $40,000 per year, guaranteed for four years (five for the B.Arch.). Apart from Canadian citizens, who may be considered for an institutional need-based grant, RPI advises international students to plan to cover the full cost of attendance.

name: University of Massachusetts Amherst
gpa_note: 평균 GPA 4.05, 석차 제출자 중 상위 10% 이내 33.8% (제출 28.1%) (2025-26 CDS)
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 4.05, 33.8% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 28.1%) (2025-26 CDS)
what_they_value: UMass 애머스트는 개별화된 holistic 입학 심사를 핵심 가치로 명시하고, 지원서의 모든 부분과 학업·개인 성취 전부를 검토한다고 밝힌다. 특히 지망 전공과 직접 관련된 과목의 엄격성을 보며, 수학 집중 전공 지원자는 관련 고교 과목에서 강한 수학 실력을 보여야 한다고 명시한다. CDS상 교과 엄격성·GPA가 Very Important.
what_they_value_en: UMass Amherst says one of its core values is a commitment to practice individualized, holistic undergraduate admissions, reviewing all parts of the application and considering all academic and personal achievements a student reports. It states that it continues to weigh the rigor of a student's high school coursework, especially courses that apply most directly to the intended major, and that applicants to math-intensive majors are expected to show strong math proficiency in related high school courses. Its CDS marks rigor of secondary school record and academic GPA as Very Important, with class rank, the essay, recommendations, extracurricular activities, talent/ability, character and work experience Important.
intro_ko: 매사추세츠주의 대표 주립 연구대학으로 5개 대학 컨소시엄(Five College)을 통해 인근 리버럴 아츠 칼리지와 수업을 공유한다.
intro_en: Massachusetts' flagship public research university; through the Five College Consortium students can take classes at nearby liberal arts colleges.
merit_note: UMass Amherst states that international undergraduate students are considered for merit scholarships by the Admissions Office as part of their admission to the university, and that first-year applicants are automatically considered with no separate application; awards are communicated in the acceptance letter and renew automatically with full-time enrollment and satisfactory academic progress. It also states that international students are not eligible for most types of financial aid because the FAFSA is limited to U.S. citizens and eligible non-citizens, and that additional scholarships may be available through a student's school, college or major.

name: University of Miami
gpa_note: 평균 GPA 3.75, 석차 제출자 중 상위 10% 이내 55.0% (제출 31.0%) (2025-26 CDS)
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.75, 55.0% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 31.0%) (2025-26 CDS)
what_they_value: 마이애미는 학업 기록, 봉사·일을 포함한 과외활동, 자기소개서, 시험 점수를 맥락 속에서 신중히 검토하는 holistic 심사를 한다고 밝힌다. CDS상 교과 엄격성·석차·GPA·시험 점수·에세이·과외활동이 Very Important로, Very Important 요소가 유난히 많은 학교다. 재능·인성·봉사·경력은 Important.
what_they_value_en: Miami says its admission counselors use a holistic process that carefully considers and contextualizes a student's academic record, extracurricular activities including community involvement and work, the personal statement, and test scores. Its CDS marks rigor of secondary school record, class rank, academic GPA, standardized test scores, the application essay and extracurricular activities as Very Important, with talent/ability, character/personal qualities, volunteer work and work experience Important. Level of applicant's interest is Considered.
intro_ko: 플로리다주의 사립 연구대학으로 해양과학·의학·경영 분야와 국제적인 학생 구성으로 알려져 있다.
intro_en: A private research university in Florida known for marine science, medicine and business, with an international student body.
merit_intl: President's Scholarship and Canes Achievement Award; Stamps Scholarship and Isaac Bashevis Singer Scholarship
merit_note: Miami states that all students who apply are automatically considered for its merit scholarships regardless of citizenship status and that no additional scholarship application is required, with the largest awards going to those who apply by the November 1 early deadlines; standard awards are the President's Scholarship (up to $30,000 per year) and the Canes Achievement Award (up to $20,000 per year). Its premier awards open to all incoming first-year students are the Stamps Scholarship (full cost of attendance plus a $12,000 enrichment fund) and the Isaac Bashevis Singer Scholarship (full tuition), while the Hammond and Weeks scholarships are limited to U.S. citizens and permanent residents.

name: Brandeis University
gpa_note: 평균 GPA 3.84, 석차 제출자 중 상위 10% 이내 39.0% (제출 19.0%) (2025-26 CDS)
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.84, 39.0% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 19.0%) (2025-26 CDS)
what_they_value: 브랜다이스는 학업 기록을 가장 먼저 본다 — CDS상 교과 엄격성·석차·GPA가 Very Important, 에세이·추천서·활동·재능이 Important, 시험·인터뷰·관심 표현은 Considered다. 대학 요람은 영어 4년, 수학 3년, 사회 3년 등 대학 준비 과정 이수를 1학년 지원 요건으로 명시한다.
what_they_value_en: Brandeis reads the full academic record first: its C7 table marks rigor of secondary school record, class rank and academic GPA as Very Important, with the application essay, recommendations, extracurricular activities and talent/ability Important, and test scores, interview and level of applicant's interest Considered. The University Bulletin states that "to be considered for first-year admission, a candidate should be enrolled in a college preparatory course of study," describing an adequate preparation as four years of English, three years of math, three years of social sciences and at least three years of a foreign language including the senior year. Test submission is optional, and applicants may instead submit three exams from an approved list spanning Science/Math, English/Social Science and a discipline of their choice.
intro_ko: 매사추세츠주 월섬의 소규모 사립 연구대학으로 인문·사회과학과 연구 중심 학부 교육으로 알려져 있다.
intro_en: A small private research university in Waltham, Massachusetts, known for the humanities and social sciences and a research-oriented undergraduate experience.
location_note_en: Located in Waltham, Massachusetts, near Boston.
merit_note: "The Wien Scholarship is awarded to exceptional international applicants who demonstrate strong academic achievement and extracurricular or community involvement" and "meets the full demonstrated financial need of each recipient"; there is no separate application - all candidates offered admission are considered. Brandeis also administers the Davis United World College Scholars Program ($10,000 grant for UWC graduates with financial need) and the Toshizo Watanabe International Scholarship for students graduating from a Japanese high school.

name: Tulane University
gpa_note: 평균 GPA 3.67, 석차 제출자 중 상위 10% 이내 53.0% (제출 20.0%) (2025-26 CDS)
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.67, 53.0% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 20.0%) (2025-26 CDS)
what_they_value: 툴레인은 시험 점수, GPA와 과목 선택, 과외활동, 에세이, 추천서를 함께 보는 holistic 심사를 하며 "단 하나의 정보로 결정을 내리지 않는다"고 명시한다. CDS상 교과 엄격성·석차·GPA에 더해 과외활동과 봉사가 Very Important인 점이 특징이다.
what_they_value_en: Tulane says it "holistically reviews applicants by reviewing standardized test scores, high school GPA and course selection, extracurricular activities, application essays, and letters of recommendation," and that "no admission decision will ever be rendered on a single piece of information but rather on the overall and holistic combination of attributes and aspects that make each applicant compelling." Its C7 table marks rigor of secondary school record, class rank, academic GPA, extracurricular activities and volunteer work as Very Important, with test scores, essay, recommendations, character, first-generation status and level of applicant's interest all Important. Tulane's dean adds that the strongest applicants are "authentically themselves" and are involved in activities they genuinely enjoy.
intro_ko: 루이지애나주 뉴올리언스의 사립 연구대학으로 공중보건·비즈니스와 봉사 학습 전통으로 알려져 있다.
intro_en: A private research university in New Orleans, Louisiana, known for public health, business and a strong service-learning tradition.
merit_note: "All applicants are considered for partial merit scholarship by completing the Common Application," and Tulane says its merit awards "may cover your full tuition and fees or may even cover your full cost of attendance"; "Tulane's Global Scholarships are renewable for 4 years (5 years for students in the 5-year Architecture program)." Separately, "Tulane offers up to $30,000 in need-based financial aid to international students," which requires the CSS Profile (recommended by February 15).

name: University of Connecticut
gpa_note_en: 45.0% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 29.0%) (2025-26 CDS)
what_they_value: UConn은 모든 1학년 지원서를 holistic하게 심사하며 "학업·개인 정보 전체에 대한 종합 검토로 선발한다"고 명시한다 — GPA·석차·에세이·활동·(선택) 추천서·(선택) 시험 어느 하나로 결정되지 않는다. GPA를 자체 재계산해 핵심 과목의 AP·IB·Honors에 가중치를 주고, 학년별 과목 난도와 성적 추이를 본다. 최근 완성된 CDS 기준 교과 엄격성·석차·GPA가 Very Important.
what_they_value_en: UConn reviews every first-year application holistically: "Selection is based on a comprehensive review of all the information provided on the application, both academic and personal," and no single element - GPA, class rank, essay, activities, optional recommendations or optional test scores - decides an outcome. The office recalculates GPA and weights advanced coursework (AP, IB, Honors) in core classes, and looks at the range and challenge level of courses taken each year plus grade trends by subject. Its most recent completed C7 table rates rigor of secondary school record, class rank, academic GPA, standardized test scores and the application essay as Very Important, with extracurriculars, character, first-generation status, talent and recommendations Important.
intro_ko: 코네티컷주의 대표 주립 연구대학으로 경영·공학·간호 분야와 강한 대학 스포츠로 알려져 있다.
intro_en: Connecticut's flagship public research university, known for business, engineering and nursing as well as its athletics.
merit_intl: Global Excellence / Global Distinction / Global Leader Award
merit_note: UConn lists the Global Excellence Award, Global Distinction Award and Global Leader Award as merit-based scholarships "available to international applicants; all campuses," renewable for four years at a fixed amount set yearly. First-year applicants are automatically considered for most merit scholarships on initial review, except the Nutmeg, Day of Pride and Stamps Scholarships, which require a supplemental application.

name: University of Pittsburgh
gpa_note: 평균 GPA 4.08, 석차 제출자 중 상위 10% 이내 41.0% (제출 31.0%) (2025-26 CDS)
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 4.08, 41.0% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 31.0%) (2025-26 CDS)
what_they_value: 피츠버그는 rolling 심사를 쓰며 "전통적 학업 지표와 함께 지원자를 특별하게 만드는 것, Pitt에 맞는 사람인지를 보는 holistic 심사"를 한다고 명시한다. "탄탄한 12학년 커리큘럼을 본다"고 덧붙인다. CDS상 교과 엄격성·GPA·에세이가 Very Important고, 재능·인성·봉사·경력·관심 표현은 Important다.
what_they_value_en: Pitt uses rolling admission and states that "every university application receives a holistic review by taking traditional measures of academic achievement into account, while also looking for what makes you unique and a good fit to attend college at Pitt." It adds, "We look for a solid senior year curriculum as part of our university admissions review." Its C7 table rates rigor of secondary school record, academic GPA and the application essay as Very Important; talent/ability, character/personal qualities, volunteer work, work experience and level of applicant's interest as Important; and class rank, test scores, recommendations and extracurriculars as Considered.
intro_ko: 펜실베이니아주 피츠버그의 주립 연계 연구대학으로 의학·보건·공학 연구가 강하다.
intro_en: A state-related research university in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, with particular strength in medicine, health sciences and engineering.
rd_timing: 롤링 (마감일 없음, 12월 초 장학금 우선 검토)
merit_note: "International first-year applicants who apply by February 1 are automatically considered for merit-based scholarships" of up to $10,000 per year, typically available for eight full-time undergraduate terms and renewable with Satisfactory Academic Progress; no separate application is required, but the international short answer, Common Application essay or a personal statement must be submitted and awards apply only to fall (August) entry.

name: Binghamton University (SUNY)
gpa_note: 평균 GPA 3.88, 석차 제출자 중 상위 10% 이내 51.0% (제출 21.0%) (2024-25 CDS)
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.88, 51.0% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 21.0%) (2024-25 CDS)
what_they_value: 빙엄턴은 test-optional로 "시험 점수는 필수가 아니며 제출은 전적으로 선택"이라 명시하고, 지원서의 모든 요소를 검토하되 고교 이후 이수한 과목을 강하게 반영한다고 밝힌다. CDS상 교과 엄격성·GPA만 Very Important, 석차·에세이는 Important.
what_they_value_en: Binghamton is test-optional - "standardized test scores are not required" and "the choice to submit test scores is entirely up to you" - and says "the Admissions Committee will fully review all pieces of the application and will strongly weigh your post-high school graduation coursework." Its C7 table marks only rigor of secondary school record and academic GPA as Very Important, with class rank and the application essay Important and test scores, recommendations, extracurricular activities, talent, character, first-generation status, volunteer work and work experience all Considered. Interview, alumni relation, state residency, religious affiliation and level of applicant's interest are Not Considered.
intro_ko: 뉴욕주립대(SUNY) 시스템의 연구 중심 캠퍼스로 학비 대비 성과가 좋은 공립으로 꼽힌다.
intro_en: A research-focused campus of the State University of New York (SUNY), often cited for strong outcomes relative to cost.

name: Clemson University
gpa_note_en: 54.57% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 61.35%) (2025-2026 CDS)
what_they_value: 클렘슨은 CDS상 교과 엄격성·석차·GPA·주 거주 여부를 Very Important로, 시험 점수를 Important로 둔다. 입학처는 "학업 능력을 입증했고 도전적인 일을 해내려는 의지가 있는 학생"을 찾는다고 밝히며, 과목과 활동을 각 고교가 제공하는 기회의 맥락에서 본다고 명시한다.
what_they_value_en: Clemson's Common Data Set rates rigor of the secondary school record, class rank, academic GPA and state residency as "very important," with standardized test scores "important" and the essay, recommendations, extracurricular activities, talent, character, first-generation status, alumni relation and geographic residence only "considered." The admissions office says it seeks "students who've proven their academic capability and are driven to accomplish challenging work that creates a brighter future," and reviews coursework and activities in the context of what each high school offers. Level of applicant's interest and interviews are not considered.
intro_ko: 사우스캐롤라이나주의 주립 연구대학으로 공학·경영과 강한 학교 커뮤니티 문화로 알려져 있다.
intro_en: A public research university in South Carolina known for engineering and business and a strong campus community culture.

name: Rutgers University--Newark
gpa_note_en: 16.0% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 18.0%) (2023-2024 CDS)
what_they_value: 럿거스 뉴어크는 CDS상 교과 엄격성·GPA를 Very Important로, 에세이를 Important로 둔다. 시험 점수·추천서·인터뷰·재능·인성은 반영하지 않는다고 표시해, 학업 기록과 에세이가 사실상 결정 요소다.
what_they_value_en: Rutgers–Newark's Common Data Set rates rigor of the secondary school record and academic GPA as "very important" and the application essay as "important." Class rank, extracurricular activities, first-generation status, geographic residence, state residency, volunteer work, work experience and level of applicant's interest are all "considered." Standardized test scores, recommendations, interviews, talent/ability and character/personal qualities are marked not considered, so the academic record and the essay carry the decision.
intro_ko: 뉴저지주 럿거스 대학교의 뉴어크 캠퍼스로, 다양성이 높은 도시형 캠퍼스이며 경영·형사사법 분야가 알려져 있다.
intro_en: The Newark campus of Rutgers University in New Jersey — a highly diverse urban campus known for business and criminal justice.

name: Syracuse University
what_they_value: 시러큐스는 학업 성취가 "특히 12학년의 과목과 성과를 포함해 입학 결정의 중요한 요소"라고 밝히고, 학교 프로파일로 과목 선택과 성적을 맥락화한다. 카운슬러 평가와 교과 교사 추천서 1부를 요구하며, 방과후 활동·봉사·아르바이트에서 조직력과 리더십을 본다고 명시한다. (CDS는 공개하지 않음)
what_they_value_en: Syracuse says academic performance is "a significant factor in our admissions decision, especially your senior-year pursuits and accomplishments," and that the school profile is used to put course selection and grades in context. It asks for a counselor evaluation and one academic teacher recommendation, which "give admissions representatives a sense of your gifts, capabilities and accomplishments," and reviews after-school activities, volunteer work and employment "to see how each illustrates your organizational and leadership skills." Syracuse adds that it looks for "more than academically prepared students" — students who innovate, take risks and show integrity and good citizenship — and several programs carry a talent component in art and design, architecture, drama and music.
intro_ko: 뉴욕주의 사립 연구대학으로 커뮤니케이션(뉴하우스)·건축·경영 분야로 알려져 있다.
intro_en: A private research university in New York known for communications (Newhouse), architecture and business.
merit_note: Syracuse's financial aid office states, "All students who apply for admission to Syracuse University are considered for merit-based scholarships, regardless of citizenship or country of birth," and that international undergraduates are considered for merit scholarships based on their application for admission. No separate scholarship application is required.

name: University at Buffalo (SUNY)
gpa_note_en: 27.0% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 32.0%) (2025-2026 CDS)
what_they_value: 버팔로는 CDS상 교과 엄격성·GPA·시험 점수를 Very Important로, 석차·추천서를 Important로 둔다. 입학처는 "학업·비학업 요소를 함께 보는 holistic 심사"를 명시하며 고교 GPA와 커리큘럼 전반의 강도를 언급한다.
what_they_value_en: UB's Common Data Set rates rigor of the secondary school record, academic GPA and standardized test scores as "very important," with class rank and recommendations "important." The essay, extracurricular activities, talent, character, first-generation status, geographic residence, racial/ethnic status, volunteer work and work experience are "considered." UB's admissions site states, "Admission to UB is based on a holistic review of each student. We consider both academic and non-academic factors, including your high school GPA and the overall strength of your academic coursework," and interviews, alumni relation and level of applicant's interest are not considered.
intro_ko: 뉴욕주립대(SUNY) 시스템에서 가장 큰 연구 캠퍼스로 공학·경영·의학 분야가 넓게 개설돼 있다.
intro_en: The largest research campus in the SUNY system, with broad offerings in engineering, business and medicine.
merit_intl: UB scholarships for incoming international first-year students
merit_note: UB states it "offers scholarships in varying amounts to qualified incoming international first-year/first-time students" and that "All admitted international students are automatically considered for scholarships during the holistic review process," renewable for up to four years if continuing eligibility requirements are met. UB advises applying by November 1 for priority scholarship consideration.

name: University of California, Riverside
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.75 (2025-2026 CDS)
what_they_value: UCR은 CDS상 GPA와 에세이(UC 개인 질문)를 Very Important로, 교과 엄격성을 Important로 둔다. UC 공통으로 시험 점수·석차·추천서·인터뷰 등은 일반 전형에서 반영하지 않는다. UC 종합 심사는 A-G 과목 GPA와 최소 요건을 넘어서는 이수를 본다.
what_they_value_en: UCR's Common Data Set rates academic GPA and the application essay (the UC personal insight questions) as "very important" and rigor of the secondary school record as "important," with talent/ability, first-generation status and state residency "considered." Standardized test scores, class rank, recommendations, interviews, extracurricular activities, character, alumni relation, geographic residence, volunteer work, work experience and level of applicant's interest are all marked not considered for general admission. UC's comprehensive review weighs the A-G grade point average, performance beyond the minimum A-G requirements and in honors/AP/IB courses, senior-year rigor, and academic accomplishment in light of the opportunities actually available at the applicant's school.
intro_ko: 캘리포니아 대학(UC) 시스템의 연구 캠퍼스로 사회이동성 지표가 높은 학교로 자주 언급된다.
intro_en: A research campus of the University of California system, frequently cited for high social-mobility outcomes.
merit_note: UCR states that first-year nonresident students "may receive up to $89,100 for four years" and that international students are automatically considered upon acceptance once confirmed as nonresidents and meeting UC eligibility requirements, with a 3.0 GPA required to keep the award while at UCR. No separate scholarship application is required.

name: Colorado School of Mines
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.85, 57.0% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 43.0%) (2022-2023 CDS)
what_they_value: 마인스는 "입학과 장학금 심사 모두에 holistic 접근"을 명시하고 선택 제출물까지 파일 전체를 읽는다고 밝힌다. STEM 중심 커리큘럼을 기대한다 — 삼각함수/미적분 준비를 포함한 대학 준비 수학 4년, 실험 과학 3년(물리 또는 화학 필수), 영어 4년, AP·IB 권장. 짧은 에세이 2편, 수상, 활동, 입학처와의 교류(engagement)도 반영한다.
what_they_value_en: Mines says its team "takes a holistic approach when reviewing each application file for admissions and merit scholarships," reading everything in the file including optional materials. It expects a STEM-heavy secondary curriculum: four units of college-prep/advanced math with trigonometry and/or pre-calculus before enrollment, three units of lab science (one must be physics or chemistry), and four years of English, with AP/IB/A-Level work encouraged. Two short-response essays, honors and awards, extracurricular activities and "admissions engagement" are also weighed, and the school is test-optional.
intro_ko: 콜로라도주의 공립 이공계 특화 대학으로 지질·에너지·자원공학 분야에서 오랜 전통을 가진다.
intro_en: A public STEM-focused university in Colorado with a long tradition in geology, energy and resource engineering.
merit_note: Mines states that "International First-Year Students are eligible for up to $8,000 in an admissions award"; the application is evaluated for merit aid by the Undergraduate Admissions Office and the award is renewable for 8 consecutive semesters toward tuition and fees. Students with an outside sponsorship may not be eligible, and the Financial Aid Office states that international students are generally not eligible for (need-based) financial aid.

name: Drexel University
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.79, 31.8% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 26.5%) (2025-2026 CDS)
what_they_value: 드렉셀은 CDS상 교과 엄격성·석차·GPA·시험 점수를 Very Important로, 에세이·추천서·인성을 Important로 둔다. "No Harm Test-Optional" — 점수 미제출이 불리하게 작용하지 않는다고 명시한다. 1·2지망 전공을 적게 하지만 전공 미정 지원도 가능하다.
what_they_value_en: Drexel's CDS rates rigor of secondary school record, class rank, academic GPA and standardized test scores as "very important," with the application essay, recommendations and character/personal qualities "important," and interview, extracurriculars, talent, first generation, alumni relation, volunteer work, work experience and level of applicant's interest "considered." Drexel practices "No Harm Test-Optional admission," meaning applicants are not required to submit scores and "test scores will never negatively impact a student's competitiveness." Applicants are encouraged to name first- and second-choice majors (or First-Year Exploratory Studies), and Westphal design/architecture/music-industry majors require a portfolio and, for architecture and music industry, a writing supplement.
intro_ko: 펜실베이니아주 필라델피아의 사립 연구대학으로 학부 전원이 참여하는 코업(co-op) 인턴십 제도로 알려져 있다.
intro_en: A private research university in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, known for its university-wide cooperative education (co-op) program.
merit_note: Drexel states that "Students admitted through Early Decision are eligible for a minimum of $20,000 in merit scholarships along with consideration for need-based aid," and its international admissions page states that "Drexel does offer need-based aid to qualifying international students." Merit awards are made by the Admissions Committee on the basis of academic performance with no separate application; per CDS H6, 1,038 nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid averaging $32,937 in 2024-2025.

name: New Jersey Institute of Technology
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.73, 30.2% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 37.4%) (2024-2025 CDS)
what_they_value: NJIT는 "학교에서 가능했던 커리큘럼 대비 얼마나 도전했는지와 성적 추이 — 특히 수학·과학·영어"를 본다고 명시하고, 영작문·대수·기하·삼각함수·화학·물리 이수를 기대한다. 상위 25% 석차나 GPA 3.0+ 수준을 목표로 하며 AP·IB가 지원서를 강화한다. 건축·디자인 전공은 포트폴리오 필수.
what_they_value_en: NJIT says it looks at "how you challenged yourself relative to the curriculum that was available at your school and the trends in your performance—especially your grades in math, science and English," and expects completed coursework in English Composition, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Chemistry and Physics. It targets students in the top 25% of their class or with a 3.0+ GPA equivalent, and AP/IB coursework strengthens an application. Essays and teacher/counselor recommendations add individual context, and applicants to architecture and design majors must submit a portfolio.
intro_ko: 뉴저지주의 공립 공과대학으로 공학·컴퓨팅·건축 중심이며 뉴욕 인근 도시형 캠퍼스다.
intro_en: New Jersey's public polytechnic university, centered on engineering, computing and architecture, on an urban campus near New York City.
merit_note: NJIT states that "Although international students aren't eligible for federal aid, there are plenty of other opportunities for financial assistance," and points international students to NJIT scholarships. Merit awards require no separate application: "Once you are admitted as a first-time, full-time freshman, your academic records such as SAT/ACT scores and high school GPA, are reviewed to determine your eligibility for NJIT scholarships," and most require full-time enrollment and a 3.0 GPA to renew. No international-specific award name or dollar amount is published officially.

name: Stevens Institute of Technology
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.83, 47.5% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 25.0%) (2025-2026 CDS)
what_they_value: 스티븐스는 "모든 제출물을 함께 고려하며 GPA와 시험 점수는 성공 가능성의 두 지표일 뿐"이라고 명시한다. CDS상 GPA가 유일한 Very Important 요소고, 교과 엄격성·에세이·추천서가 Important다. 의예·법예 가속 프로그램 지원자만 시험 제출이 필수다.
what_they_value_en: Stevens says it considers "all of your application materials in making our admissions decisions" and that "GPAs and test scores are only two indicators of your potential success at Stevens." Its CDS rates academic GPA as the only "very important" factor, with rigor of secondary school record, the application essay and recommendations rated "important," and test scores, extracurriculars, talent, character and level of applicant's interest "considered." Applicants to the Accelerated Pre-Medicine and Pre-Law programs are the exception to test-optional and must submit scores (Accelerated Pre-Medicine: Regular Decision with a November 1 deadline, minimum SAT 1400 or ACT 32).
intro_ko: 뉴저지주 호보컨의 사립 공과대학으로 맨해튼 강 건너에 있으며 공학·금융공학 분야로 알려져 있다.
intro_en: A private technological university in Hoboken, New Jersey, across the river from Manhattan, known for engineering and financial engineering.
merit_note: Stevens states that "Stevens awards a limited number of merit scholarships to international students" and that it "may offer a merit based Global Scholarship to international students with exceptional academic achievement." International students who want to be considered for institutional scholarships must file the CSS Profile (school code 2819); no dollar amounts are published.

name: Pepperdine University
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.57 (2025-2026 CDS)
what_they_value: 페퍼다인 입학위원회는 학업 기록, GPA, (제출 시) 시험 점수, 봉사·리더십 경험, 추천서와 글에서 드러나는 인성을 자세히 본다고 밝힌다. 교실 밖 성취와 리더십, 지적 호기심, 영적 관심을 중시하며, 페퍼다인의 가치(목적·봉사·리더십)에 기여할 잠재력을 본다고 명시한다. CDS상 종교적 헌신이 Very Important에 포함되는 드문 학교다.
what_they_value_en: The admission committee looks closely at an applicant's academic record, GPA, standardized test scores (if submitted), background of service and leadership, and character as exhibited in references and short answer/personal statements. It values achievements outside the classroom and looks for strong leadership qualities, intellectual curiosity, and spiritual interest, as well as a student's potential to make a significant, positive contribution to the Pepperdine community, considering how an applicant's experiences demonstrate Pepperdine's values of purpose, service, and leadership. Every first-year applicant must answer a required 300-500 word Pepperdine essay on why they are interested in attending a Christian university and how they would contribute to conversations of faith on campus.
intro_ko: 캘리포니아주 말리부 해안의 사립 기독교 대학으로 소규모 학부 교육과 해외 프로그램으로 알려져 있다.
intro_en: A private Christian university on the Malibu coast of California, known for small undergraduate classes and study-abroad programs.
merit_intl: Blanche E. Seaver International Scholars' Awards
merit_note: All admitted students are automatically considered for the Blanche E. Seaver International Scholars' Awards; no separate application is required, and the merit-based award is offered to a limited number of candidates. Recipients must maintain a 3.25 Pepperdine cumulative GPA and full-time status; Pepperdine also names the Charles Lam Scholarship ($8,000-$10,000/yr, citizens of Mainland China) and the Lydia Hayne Scholarship Fund (full tuition, room and board, citizens of an African country, offered once every four years).

name: University of Illinois Chicago
gpa_note: 평균 GPA 3.45, 석차 제출자 중 상위 10% 이내 23% (제출 36%) (2025-2026 CDS)
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.45, 23% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 36%) (2025-2026 CDS)
what_they_value: UIC는 학업 준비도와 커뮤니티 기여 가능성을 중심으로 심사하며, 고교 성적(과목 선택과 엄격성, GPA)과 에세이(글의 질, 학업적 관심의 표현)에 집중한다고 밝힌다. 단과대별 기준이 달라 공학·CS·생명과학·프리헬스 등 STEM 계열은 수학·과학 기대치가 다를 수 있다. 시험 점수는 필수가 아니다.
what_they_value_en: UIC admissions counselors review each application for academic preparedness and potential contribution to the UIC community, focusing on high school performance (course selection and rigor, grade point average) and on the essays, where they look for quality of writing and demonstration of academic interest. Each college within the university has its own criteria when selecting applicants, so STEM-related fields such as engineering, computer science, biological sciences and pre-health majors may have different expectations for high school math and science. ACT or SAT scores are not required for admission but will be reviewed if provided.
intro_ko: 시카고 도심의 공립 연구대학으로 의료·보건 계열 규모가 크고 학생 구성이 다양하다.
intro_en: A public research university in downtown Chicago with large health-science programs and a highly diverse student body.

name: Worcester Polytechnic Institute
gpa_note: 평균 GPA 3.9, 석차 제출자 중 상위 10% 이내 51% (제출 33%) (2025-2026 CDS)
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.9, 51% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 33%) (2025-2026 CDS)
what_they_value: WPI는 7주 4학기제의 빠른 프로젝트 기반 커리큘럼에서 성공할 수 있는지를 평가한다고 명시한다. 정량·정성 지표를 함께 보는 holistic 심사로, 학업 성취, 개인적 성취 기록, 커뮤니티 참여와 기여를 고려한다. "학생은 시험 점수 그 이상"이라는 입장을 명시한다.
what_they_value_en: The Admissions staff evaluates every application to assess whether the student will be successful in WPI's fast-paced, project-based curriculum of four 7-week terms with ample opportunities to complete projects and research on and off campus. The staff uses a holistic approach, carefully weighing both quantitative and qualitative measures of success and student potential, taking into consideration each applicant's academic performance, their record of personal accomplishments, and the extent of their involvement and contribution to their community. WPI states that students are more than their SAT or ACT score and encourages applicants to showcase their potential through maker creations, research findings, artwork, writing, CAD designs, personal websites, and anything else that helps admissions learn more about them.
intro_ko: 매사추세츠주의 사립 공과대학으로 프로젝트 기반 교육과정(프로젝트 필수 이수)으로 알려져 있다.
intro_en: A private technological university in Massachusetts known for its project-based curriculum with required project requirements.
merit_note: WPI offers competitive academic merit-based scholarships to first-year and transfer applicants based on academic performance, leadership experiences, extracurricular involvement, and community service; all applicants for admission are automatically considered and no additional application is required. IB diploma graduates with a diploma score of 40 or greater admitted as first-year students are guaranteed a merit scholarship worth a minimum of $25,000, and starting with students entering in fall 2026 all students admitted under an Early Decision plan are offered a minimum merit scholarship of $25,000 per year for up to four years.

name: Yeshiva University
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.49 (2023-2024 CDS)
what_they_value: 예시바는 holistic 심사를 하며 모든 지원자에게 입학사정관 인터뷰를 요구한다 — 지원서 밖에서 학생을 알기 위해서다. 에세이, 250단어 자기소개(예시바가 학업 목표와 가치 속 성장을 어떻게 도울지), 활동 목록, 리더십·창의성·잠재력을 말해줄 추천서를 제출한다.
what_they_value_en: Yeshiva University takes a holistic approach in reviewing an applicant's candidacy, and an interview with an admissions officer is required of all applicants so that the admissions officer can meet the student and get to know them outside of their application. Applicants submit an essay, a 250-word personal statement on how they see Yeshiva University supporting their academic goals while helping them grow personally and within their values, a resume or extracurricular activity list, and letters of recommendation from someone who can speak to their leadership, creativity, and potential. Standardized test scores are required only for applicants to the Honors program; all other applicants are invited but not required to submit them.
intro_ko: 뉴욕시의 사립 대학으로 유대교 전통에 기반한 학부 교육과정을 운영한다.
intro_en: A private university in New York City offering an undergraduate curriculum grounded in the Jewish tradition.
location_note_en: Located in New York City, New York.
merit_note: Yeshiva University's international admissions page states that YU offers merit-based scholarships to international students, and that although U.S. federal and state financial aid is not available to non-citizens, students may also be considered for institutional need-based aid; an international aid application is added to the applicant portal after applying. No named international merit program is published on the official admissions pages.

name: American University
what_they_value: AU는 지원자를 학업과 교실 밖 양면에서 알고 싶다고 밝히며, 합격자는 대개 최소 요건을 넘는 엄격한 대학 준비 과정을 이수했다고 명시한다. CDS상 교과 엄격성·GPA와 함께 관심 표현(Level of applicant's interest)이 Very Important 3요소에 들어가는 드문 학교다. 시험 점수는 Considered에 그친다.
what_they_value_en: AU says its Admissions Committee wants to know about the applicant both academically and outside the classroom, and that successful candidates have usually completed a rigorous college-preparatory program going beyond the minimum requirements. In the 2025-26 CDS, rigor of secondary school record, academic GPA and level of applicant's interest are the three factors rated 'very important'; essay, recommendations, extracurricular activities, talent, character and volunteer work are 'important'. Test scores are only 'considered'.
intro_ko: 워싱턴 D.C.의 사립 대학으로 국제관계·정치·공공정책 분야와 수도 인턴십 기회로 알려져 있다.
intro_en: A private university in Washington, D.C., known for international relations, politics and public policy, with internship access in the capital.
merit_note: AU states that qualified international first-year applicants are automatically considered, with no separate application, for partial merit scholarships of $8,000 to $25,000 per year, renewable for four years. The separately-applied AU Emerging Global Leader Scholarship covers all billable expenses for two students, with up to eight additional partial awards of up to $40,000 per year. AU states that no need-based financial aid is available to international students.

name: Baylor University
gpa_note_en: 42.0% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 49.0%) (2025-2026 CDS)
what_they_value: 베일러는 CDS상 GPA와 시험 점수를 Very Important로, 교과 엄격성과 에세이를 Important로 둔다. 시험 제출은 선택이지만 제출 여부 결정은 신중히 하라고, 그리고 최종적이라고 명시한다. ED 지원자는 베일러에서 무엇을 찾는지에 대한 단답 문항을 추가로 쓴다.
what_they_value_en: Baylor's Common Data Set rates academic GPA and standardized test scores as 'very important,' with rigor of secondary school record and the application essay 'important,' and class rank, recommendations and every nonacademic factor - including level of applicant's interest - 'considered.' Students are not required to submit standardized test scores for admission, and Baylor states that the decision to apply with or without scores should be carefully thought through and is considered final. Early Decision applicants must additionally answer a short-answer question about what they are looking for in a university, why they want to attend Baylor, and how they see themselves contributing to the Baylor community.
intro_ko: 텍사스주의 사립 침례교 계열 연구대학으로 보건·경영 분야와 신앙 기반 교육 전통을 가진다.
intro_en: A private Baptist-affiliated research university in Texas with health sciences and business programs and a faith-based educational tradition.
merit_note: Admitted first-time international students are automatically considered for merit-based scholarships based on a complete review of their high school academic performance. For need-based consideration Baylor requires the CSS Profile (code 6032) by the November 1 priority deadline or the February 1 regular deadline; beginning with Fall 2027 a new Baylor International Financial Aid Application (BIFAA) opens October 1 with a November 1 priority and February 1 final deadline.

name: Howard University
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.68 (2025-2026 CDS)
what_they_value: 하워드는 "holistic 심사의 일부로 고교 학업 기록, SAT/ACT, 학교·커뮤니티 리더십, 고유한 재능과 기술, 교육 목표를 고려한다"고 명시한다. CDS상 교과 엄격성·GPA·시험 점수가 Very Important, 인성이 Important다. (제출은 선택이지만 제출 시 강하게 반영)
what_they_value_en: Howard states: 'As part of our holistic admission process, we consider student's secondary school academic record, standardized college entrance exams (SAT or ACT), leadership in school and community activities, unique talents and skills, and educational objectives.' The 2025-26 CDS rates rigor of secondary school record, academic GPA and standardized test scores as 'very important', with character/personal qualities 'important' and class rank, essay, recommendations, extracurriculars, talent, first generation, alumni relation, volunteer work, work experience and level of applicant's interest all 'considered'.
intro_ko: 워싱턴 D.C.의 사립 연구대학이자 대표적인 역사적 흑인대학(HBCU)으로 의학·법학·언론 분야 전통이 깊다.
intro_en: A private research university in Washington, D.C., and a leading historically Black college and university (HBCU) with deep traditions in medicine, law and journalism.
merit_note: Howard states that international applicants must submit the HU ISFAA to be considered for financial aid, and that applicants who do not submit test scores receive equal consideration for scholarships based on other academic achievements. Applying by the deadline of the chosen admission plan is required for priority scholarship consideration. No international-specific named merit program is published on the admission site.

name: Marquette University
gpa_note: 평균 GPA 3.6, 석차 제출자 중 상위 10% 이내 28.0% (제출 24.0%) (2025-2026 CDS)
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.6, 28.0% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 24.0%) (2025-2026 CDS)
what_they_value: 마켓은 학업 성취와 함께 재능·리더십·봉사활동, 에세이, 학교 프로파일, 추천서, 지원자가 내는 추가 자료까지 holistic하게 검토한다고 밝힌다. CDS상 교과 엄격성·GPA만 Very Important고 시험·에세이·활동·봉사는 Important다. 관심 표현은 반영하지 않는다.
what_they_value_en: Marquette reviews applications holistically, considering academic achievement together with a student's unique talents, leadership and service activities, application essay, school profile, letters of recommendation and any other information a student wishes to submit. In the 2025-26 CDS, only rigor of secondary school record and academic GPA are rated 'very important'; test scores, the essay, extracurricular activities and volunteer work are 'important'. Level of applicant's interest is 'not considered'.
intro_ko: 위스콘신주 밀워키의 사립 예수회(가톨릭) 대학으로 보건·공학·경영 분야가 알려져 있다.
intro_en: A private Jesuit (Catholic) university in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, known for health sciences, engineering and business.
merit_note: All admitted international undergraduates are automatically considered for Marquette merit scholarships, including the Père Marquette Award, at the time of admission; some additional merit scholarships require a separate application after admission. Marquette states that it is not able to award need-based scholarships to international students.

name: Rochester Institute of Technology
gpa_note: 평균 GPA 3.9, 석차 제출자 중 상위 10% 이내 40.0% (제출 39.0%) (2025-2026 CDS)
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.9, 40.0% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 39.0%) (2025-2026 CDS)
what_they_value: RIT는 "학업 역량, (선택 제출) 시험 점수, 추천서, (해당 시) 포트폴리오, 과외활동과 진로 관심"을 검토한다고 명시한다. "differential admissions — 전공/단과대에 직접 지원"을 실시하므로 기록과 지망 전공의 정합성이 중요하다. CDS상 교과 엄격성·GPA만 Very Important.
what_they_value_en: RIT states that it reviews 'academic strength, standardized test scores (if you choose to take them), recommendations, portfolio quality (where applicable), as well as extracurricular activities and personal career interests.' RIT also states that it 'practices differential admissions, meaning students apply directly to their specific major or academic college,' so the fit between a student's record and the chosen major matters. In the 2025-26 CDS only rigor of secondary school record and academic GPA are 'very important', with class rank, test scores, essay, recommendations and character 'important'.
intro_ko: 뉴욕주의 사립 공과대학으로 컴퓨팅·게임디자인·이미징 분야와 코업(co-op) 제도로 알려져 있다.
intro_en: A private technological university in New York known for computing, game design and imaging, with a strong cooperative education (co-op) program.
merit_note: RIT states that first-year merit scholarships range from $14,000 to $30,000 annually ($56,000 to $120,000 over the degree) and that all applicants, including international applicants, are considered for merit scholarships just by applying, with awards announced at the time of admission. RIT states that full-cost or full-tuition scholarships are not typically offered to undergraduates and that only very limited need-based funding is available; total support must reach at least $78,000 USD for RIT to issue the I-20.

name: Southern Methodist University
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.69, 48.7% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 24.2%) (2025-2026 CDS)
what_they_value: SMU는 GPA·시험 점수 외에 수업 성취, 커리큘럼 엄격성, 에세이와 추천서의 질, 과외활동, 재능, 인성, 삶의 경험 등 여러 요소를 함께 본다고 밝힌다. 완전 test-optional로 제출 여부에 따른 우대는 없지만, 미제출 시 나머지 요소의 비중이 커진다고 명시한다.
what_they_value_en: SMU states that in addition to GPA and SAT or ACT scores, its admission committee weighs many factors including classroom performance, the rigor of the high school curriculum, quality of essays and recommendations, extracurricular activities, talents, character, and life experiences. SMU is fully test-optional and gives no preference based on whether scores are submitted, but notes that without test scores all other elements - grades, resume, essays and recommendation letters - become more important. Its Common Data Set rates rigor of secondary school record, academic GPA, the application essay, and recommendations as 'very important,' and rates level of applicant's interest as 'considered.'
intro_ko: 텍사스주 댈러스의 사립 연구대학으로 경영(콕스)·예술 분야와 도시 인접 입지로 알려져 있다.
intro_en: A private research university in Dallas, Texas, known for business (Cox), the arts, and its metropolitan setting.
merit_note: All students who apply to SMU, regardless of citizenship, are automatically considered for SMU's academic merit scholarships with no separate application. Automatic consideration requires applying by November 1 (Early Decision I / Early Action) or January 15 (Early Decision II / Regular Decision); need-based financial aid is available only to U.S. citizens and permanent residents.

name: University of California, Santa Cruz
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.87 (2025-2026 CDS)
what_they_value: UC 산타크루즈는 UC 캠퍼스로서 SAT/ACT를 입학·장학 심사에 반영하지 않는다. UC 종합 심사는 A-G 과목 GPA, 최소 요건을 넘어선 이수, UC 인증 honors·AP 성취, 12학년 과정의 질, 학교가 제공한 기회 대비 성취를 본다. CDS상 교과 엄격성·GPA·에세이가 핵심이다.
what_they_value_en: As a University of California campus, UC Santa Cruz will not consider SAT or ACT scores in admission decisions or in awarding scholarships; selection is made through comprehensive review of the UC application. UC weighs GPA in completed A-G courses, the number and content of A-G subjects taken beyond the minimum, performance in UC-approved honors and AP courses, the quality of the senior-year program, and academic performance relative to the educational opportunities available at the student's school. In its Common Data Set, UCSC rates rigor of secondary school record, academic GPA, the application essay, and state residency as 'very important,' and rates level of applicant's interest as 'not considered.'
intro_ko: 캘리포니아 대학(UC) 시스템의 캠퍼스로 숲과 해안에 걸친 캠퍼스와 천문학·컴퓨팅 연구로 알려져 있다.
intro_en: A University of California campus set among redwoods above the coast, known for astronomy and computing research.
merit_note: Newly admitted out-of-state and international first-year students are automatically considered for the Undergraduate Dean's Award during the admissions cycle; first-year awards range from $12,000 to $100,000 paid evenly over four years ($3,000-$25,000 per year). International students are not eligible for federal, state, or university need-based aid.

name: University of Delaware
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.98, 31.5% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 36.4%) (2024-2025 CDS)
what_they_value: 델라웨어는 holistic 심사를 하며 "성적이 지원서에서 가장 중요한 부분"이라고 명시한다 — 커리큘럼 엄격성과 지망 전공 관련 과목 성취를 본다. 학업 외에는 긴 활동 목록보다 꾸준하고 질 높은 참여를 찾고, 에세이와 교사 추천서로 인성을 파악한다. CDS상 교과 엄격성·GPA·주 거주가 Very Important.
what_they_value_en: UD reviews applications holistically and states that grades are the most important part of any college application, with attention to curriculum rigor and to performance in courses related to the intended major. Beyond academics, counselors look for sustained, quality involvement outside the classroom rather than a long list of activities, and use the essay and teacher recommendations to understand character. In its Common Data Set, UD rates rigor of secondary school record, academic GPA, and state residency as 'very important.'
intro_ko: 델라웨어주의 대표 주립 연구대학으로 공학·화학·경영 분야가 알려져 있다.
intro_en: Delaware's flagship public research university, known for engineering, chemistry and business.
merit_note: All first-year international applicants are automatically considered for UD merit scholarships of $5,000-$15,000 per year, with no separate scholarship application. International students may also compete for UD's Distinguished Scholars awards, which can cover tuition plus room and board for four years if a 3.0 GPA is maintained.

name: University of South Florida
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 4.09, 29.1% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 71.6%) (2025-2026 CDS)
what_they_value: USF는 지원자를 개별적으로 보며 성적, 커리큘럼 엄격성, 시험 점수를 고려한다고 명시한다(SAT/ACT 필수). AP·IB·AICE 이수와 성적 추이, 5개 핵심 과목군 18단위(경쟁력 있는 지원자는 20단위) 이수를 본다. CDS상 교과 엄격성·GPA·시험 점수가 Very Important.
what_they_value_en: USF states that it looks at each applicant individually, considering grades, rigor of curriculum, and standardized test scores. It also evaluates strength of curriculum (encouraging AP, IB and AICE coursework), grade trend across high school, and completion of at least 18 approved academic units across five core subject areas, noting that the most competitive applicants typically complete 20 units. Its Common Data Set rates rigor of secondary school record, academic GPA, and standardized test scores as 'very important,' while essays, recommendations, extracurricular activities, and level of applicant's interest are all 'not considered.'
intro_ko: 플로리다주 탬파의 대형 주립 연구대학으로 최근 연구 규모가 빠르게 성장했다.
intro_en: A large public research university in Tampa, Florida, with rapidly grown research activity in recent years.
merit_note: Admitted international students are automatically considered, with no separate application, for the Green and Gold Presidential (about $44,000 total, up to $11,000 per year), Directors (about $36,000, up to $9,000 per year), and Scholars (about $20,000, up to $5,000 per year) waiver awards. These are partial out-of-state tuition waivers, require completing the freshman application by the January 15 scholarship deadline, and cannot be combined with another tuition-waiver scholarship.

name: Florida International University
gpa_note: 평균 GPA 4.0, 석차 제출자 중 상위 10% 이내 23.0% (제출 76.0%) (2025-2026 CDS)
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 4.0, 23.0% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 76.0%) (2025-2026 CDS)
what_they_value: FIU는 선발적 입학을 명시하며, 플로리다 주 규정에 따른 최소 요건 기반 선발이라고 CDS에 밝힌다. 교과 엄격성·석차·GPA·시험 점수 4가지가 Very Important고, SAT/ACT는 필수이며 영역별 최소 점수 요건이 있다.
what_they_value_en: FIU describes its admission as selective, stating that it receives thousands of applications each year from students with varying academic profiles and considers each student for admission to a best-fit start term based on their entire academic profile. Its Common Data Set explains the policy as 'Selective admissions based on meeting minimum requirements set forth by Florida Board of Governors,' and rates rigor of the secondary school record, class rank, academic GPA and standardized test scores as 'very important.' SAT or ACT scores are required, with minimum subscores needed for admission, and all first-time-in-college students take a math placement test.
intro_ko: 플로리다주 마이애미의 대형 주립 연구대학으로 국제경영·호스피탈리티 분야와 다양한 학생 구성으로 알려져 있다.
intro_en: A large public research university in Miami, Florida, known for international business and hospitality and a highly diverse student body.
merit_note: FIU states it automatically considers admitted first-time-in-college students for merit-based scholarships when they submit and complete the freshman admissions application by the posted date (December 3, 2025 for students attending out-of-state or overseas high schools for Early Fall/Fall 2026), including official SAT, ACT or CLT scores. Eligible students must be U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or international students receiving an F-1 (or another eligible) visa; no additional application is required.

name: Fordham University
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.63, 34.3% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 22.9%) (2024-2025 CDS)
what_they_value: 포덤은 "항상 holistic 심사를 해왔다"고 밝히며, 학업 성공 가능성과 함께 성실함·끈기·리더십을 캠퍼스에 가져올 학생을 찾는다고 명시한다. 제출된 모든 요소(필수·선택)를 전체의 일부로 보고 어느 하나만 떼어 보지 않으며, 카운슬러와 학교 프로파일이 주는 맥락을 고려한다.
what_they_value_en: Fordham says it has always employed a holistic admission process, meaning it looks for students who are a good match for Fordham, with the primary focus on whether the applicant will be academically successful and will bring personal qualities of integrity, perseverance and leadership to campus. Every element submitted — required and optional — is considered as part of the greater whole, with no single element viewed in isolation, and the school and community context provided by the counselor and school profile is taken into account. Fordham also seeks to understand how applicants will give back to Fordham and to their local, national and international communities through service and social justice, in keeping with its Jesuit mission.
intro_ko: 뉴욕시의 사립 예수회(가톨릭) 대학으로 경영·인문 분야와 뉴욕 도심 접근성으로 알려져 있다.
intro_en: A private Jesuit (Catholic) university in New York City, known for business and the humanities and its access to the city.
location_note_en: Located in New York City, New York.
merit_note: Fordham states that all complete applications for admission are automatically considered for merit scholarships, that no supplementary materials are required, and that merit award notifications are included within the online admission letter. Its International Student Scholarships page lists competitive four-year awards, including the full-tuition Presidential Scholarship for entering first-year students who generally rank in the top 1-2 percent of their high school class.

name: Rutgers University--Camden
gpa_note_en: 13.0% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 22.0%) (2023-2024 CDS)
what_they_value: 럿거스 캠던은 학업 잠재력에 1차 비중을 두는 holistic 심사를 명시한다 — 필수 과목 이수, 프로그램 강도(일반·honors·AP 과목 수), 성적과 추이, 가중 GPA, (가능 시) 석차, (선택) SAT/ACT, (필요 시) 영어 공인 점수. 에세이, 대학 준비 프로그램 참여, 봉사를 포함한 활동도 고려한다.
what_they_value_en: Rutgers–Camden states that decisions are based on a holistic review with primary emphasis on an applicant's academic promise, as demonstrated by completion of required high school subjects, strength of academic program (number and type of academic, honors or AP courses), grades and grade trends, weighted GPA, cumulative rank when available, optional SAT/ACT scores, and English proficiency exam results when required. It also considers the personal essay, participation in college-preparation programs, extracurricular activities including community and volunteer work, U.S. military service, honors and awards, and employment history. The number of applicants admitted to each school or college depends on the quality of the applicant pool and the space in the entering class.
intro_ko: 뉴저지주 럿거스 대학교의 캠던 캠퍼스로, 소규모 수업 중심이며 필라델피아와 인접해 있다.
intro_en: The Camden campus of Rutgers University in New Jersey — smaller classes, adjacent to Philadelphia.
merit_note: Rutgers–Camden states it will offer scholarships of up to $21,000 to all non-sponsored international applicants who meet admission requirements and enroll full time, with no separate application required and automatic consideration on admission. The award is renewable if the student maintains a 2.5 GPA at Rutgers–Camden, and international students are encouraged to apply by the early action or regular decision due dates because scholarship funds are limited.

name: Texas Christian University
gpa_note_en: 45.6% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 36.5%) (2025-2026 CDS)
what_they_value: TCU는 CDS상 교과 엄격성·GPA만 Very Important로 둔다. 에세이·활동·인성·1세대 여부·봉사·경력이 Important고, 시험 점수·추천서·재능·종교는 Considered다. test-optional이며 지원 시 제출 여부를 표시한다.
what_they_value_en: In its 2025-2026 Common Data Set, TCU rates only rigor of the secondary school record and academic GPA as 'very important' in first-year admission decisions. The application essay, extracurricular activities, character/personal qualities, first-generation status, volunteer work and work experience are rated 'important,' while standardized test scores, recommendations, talent/ability, state residency, religious affiliation and level of applicant's interest are 'considered.' TCU is test-optional (SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted') and requires applicants to indicate business or nursing as an intended major for admission into those programs.
intro_ko: 텍사스주 포트워스의 사립 대학으로 경영·간호 분야와 소규모 수업 중심 학부 교육으로 알려져 있다.
intro_en: A private university in Fort Worth, Texas, known for business and nursing and a small-class undergraduate focus.
merit_note: TCU states that two types of assistance are available to incoming international students — academic scholarships and need-based financial aid — and that applicants are automatically considered for academic scholarships when they apply for admission. Need-based awards range from $2,000 to $41,570 and require the College Board CSS/Financial Aid PROFILE (TCU code 6820) by February 1 for first-year fall applicants; TCU notes it does not offer full-funding awards.

name: University of Colorado Boulder
gpa_note_en: Average HS GPA 3.77, 26.3% in the top 10% of class among rank submitters (submitted by 41.3%) (2025-2026 CDS)
what_they_value: CU 볼더는 "높은 자질과 지적 호기심, 활발한 참여, 성숙함과 성실성, 커뮤니티 봉사 의지"를 가진 학생을 뽑는다고 명시한다. holistic 심사에서 1차 요소는 학업 성취 — 핵심 과목 성적, 학교가 제공한 기회 대비 과목 선택의 엄격성, (표준화 가중 4점 척도로 재계산한) GPA다. SAT/ACT는 필수가 아니다.
what_they_value_en: CU Boulder says it enrolls students who are highly qualified, intellectually curious and actively involved, and who have shown maturity, personal integrity and a commitment to serving their communities. It practices a holistic admission review in which the primary factor is academic achievement — classroom performance in core academic courses, the rigor of course selection relative to the opportunities available at the applicant's school, and GPA (recalculated on a standardized, weighted 4-point scale). SAT and ACT scores are not required, and applicants are evaluated individually relative to a prediction of academic success in their intended major.

intro_en: Colorado's flagship public research university, known for aerospace and environmental science research, at the foot of the Rocky Mountains.
merit_note: CU Boulder states that international students are eligible for a few merit-based CU Boulder scholarships and that the university cannot provide federal financial aid to international students; it does not accept the College Board International Student Financial Aid Application. Athletic and College of Music scholarships (full or partial) are occasionally available to very talented individuals.
